summary: Decodes one frame of compressed audio from the input bitstream into 16-bit PCM output. Returns -1 when the bitstream buffer pointer (this[2345]) is null. When the codec is initialized (dword_8B0108 nonzero) it reads nibble-coded selectors, decodes Huffman-coded VQ index pairs (stereo, mode 2) or single-selector VQ (mono) via DecodeHuffmanPair and table lookups, then resamples 12 blocks with AudioResampler. When uninitialized it reads raw selectors (8-bit split in stereo, 4-bit in mono), dequantizes against flt_5B11A4 and converts 12 blocks with AudioMixerFloatingPointTo16BitPCMConversion. The output cursor advances by 2*this[2356] per block. Called by sub_52DF10.

operations.description: Load the input bitstream buffer pointer this[2345]; when null, return -1 immediately.
Branch on the codec-initialized flag dword_8B0108: nonzero selects the table/Huffman decode path, zero selects the raw uninitialized decode path.
Mode guard on this[2355] == 2 (stereo) versus mono: stereo reads two nibbles per byte and processes paired channels, mono reads one nibble stream.

Read selector nibbles from the bitstream at buffer + (cursor >> 3): each byte splits into a high and a low nibble; the block consumes 256 bits (stereo) or 128 bits (mono) of cursor advance on this[2346].

For each nonzero selector, read a 6-bit VLC value from the bitstream via a byte-swapped big-endian shift (byteswap >> (6 - cursor & 7)) masked to 6 bits; each such read advances the cursor by 6 bits. Values land in the selector-index workspace (stack v162 in the initialized path, dword_8B0124 in the raw path).

Stereo initialized path: 12 iterations, each calling DecodeHuffmanPair 32 times (pair index 0..31) against codebook table unk_5B2BA4, decoding Huffman-coded VQ index pairs into successive 128-byte blocks.
Stereo initialized path: 12 iterations of AudioResampler, resampling each decoded 128-sample block to the output buffer; the output pointer advances by 2*this[2356] per block.

Mono initialized path: 12 blocks of 30-sample VQ decode. Each selector reads Huffman bits using the length/code table dword_5B4788[sel+1] and the base table dword_5B4820[sel], indexed into codebook dword_5B2CA4[64*sel + index], producing 16-bit output words per block.

Raw (uninitialized) selector read: stereo reads one byte per sample and splits it into two 4-bit nibbles (advancing 8 bits); mono reads 4 bits per sample (advancing 4 bits). Selectors are stored in workspace unk_8B0324.

Raw (uninitialized) dequantize: 12 blocks of 32 samples; each nonzero selector computes a residual against workspace dword_8B0224 and scales it by the float table flt_5B11A4[64*sel + code] into float sample workspace.
Raw path: 12 iterations of AudioMixerFloatingPointTo16BitPCMConversion converting each float sample block to 16-bit PCM at the output pointer, which advances by 2*this[2356] per block.
Return 0 on success after the decode loops, or -1 when no input bitstream buffer is present.
Invoked by sub_52DF10 (0052df10) to decode one frame of compressed audio.
